name: GET /admin/pools — api-gateway
description: Lists every routing pool for the projexcloud-admin /pools page — pool_index, region, isolation_class, status, replication_role, replicates_from_pool_index and timestamps — ordered by region then pool_index, as { success: true, data: rows }. QA edge cases: no filtering, no pagination and no LIMIT, so the whole routing.pool table comes back and response size grows with the fleet; pools in every status (ACTIVE, MIGRATING, DRAINING, MAINTENANCE, RETIRED, QUARANTINE) are returned together with no status filter, so tests expecting only live pools must filter client-side; an empty table is a 200 with data: [], never 404; the route is ops-token gated rather than JWT gated and is fully cross-tenant.

errorCases.when: requireAdmin() found no valid x-admin-ops-token header — missing, or matching neither env ADMIN_OPS_TOKEN nor an active admin.ops_token hash (30s cache TTL applies to revocations)
the SELECT against routing.pool throws — Postgres unavailable, pool exhausted, or the routing schema missing
